Protocol C - CDS (the standard protocol)

Protocol cds protocol wellness

Evidence: Grade B (traditional_use)

Summary

Oral CDS protocol (Protocol C) is the most widely used method to treat various diseases and is also an effective procedure for detoxification. 1 ml CDS in 100ml water every hour, up to 8 doses daily, then reduce to maintenance dose as needed. This protocol is the most common and is indicated in case of doubts about how to get started.

Indications

  • CDS standard protocol
  • Standard
  • General dosing

Steps

  1. Prepare 1 ml CDS in 100ml purified water
  2. Take 1 dose every hour for up to 8 consecutive hours daily
  3. Start with lower dose if new to CDS
  4. After 8 doses, reduce to maintenance dose as needed
  5. Continue for 10-30 days depending on condition severity

Dosage

1 ml CDS in 100ml water every hour, up to 8 doses daily, then reduce to maintenance dose

Expected Outcomes

  • Pathogen destruction through oxidation
  • Poison and toxin elimination
  • Reduction of edema and inflammation
  • Improved overall wellness and energy

Monitoring

  • Monitor for detoxification symptoms
  • Stay well hydrated with additional water
  • Reduce dose if nausea or discomfort occurs
  • Consult with healthcare provider if symptoms worsen

Frequency: Every hour, up to 8 doses daily
